description: I appreciate this opportunity to join my legislative colleagues to try to advance a broader and more transparent public discussion surrounding New York State's aggressive push to site large-scale solar projects in communities, particularly rural communities across the upstate region. title: O'Mara, Senate colleagues hold energy roundtable: Today’s roundtable discussion centered on large-scale solar projects, their impacts on local communities
